seoTitle: How to Reset TradingView Paper Trading Account
metaDescription: Learn how to reset your TradingView Paper Trading account, close open positions first, restore your default balance, and fix a missing reset option.
intro: After a string of practice losses or a testing session, starting fresh in TradingView Paper Trading can help you reset your mindset along with your balance. This guide covers how to close open positions, reset your account balance, and troubleshoot cases where the reset option isn't showing up. It's aimed at beginners and strategy testers who want a clean slate for practice.

steps.heading: Open the Paper Trading panel
steps.body: Navigate to the Paper Trading section within TradingView to access your simulated account settings.

steps.heading: Close all open positions
steps.body: Before resetting, close any open trades so your account doesn't carry unresolved positions into the reset.

steps.heading: Reset your account balance
steps.body: Use the reset option within Paper Trading settings to restore your account back to its default starting balance.

steps.heading: Fix a missing reset option
steps.body: If the reset button isn't visible, try refreshing the page or checking a different account menu location, as this can sometimes be layout related.

steps.heading: Apply tips for a fresh start with better risk management
steps.body: Use the clean slate as an opportunity to set clearer rules around position sizing and risk before your next round of practice trades.

faq.question: Do I need to close open trades before resetting Paper Trading?
faq.answer: Yes, it's recommended to close all open positions first so the reset properly restores your account without leftover trades.

faq.question: Will resetting Paper Trading affect my real trading account?
faq.answer: No, Paper Trading is a separate simulated account and resetting it has no impact on any real money trading account.

faq.question: What should I do if the reset option isn't visible?
faq.answer: Try refreshing the page or checking your account settings menu again, since the reset option can sometimes be harder to locate depending on your layout.

faq.question: How often can I reset my Paper Trading balance?
faq.answer: You can typically reset your Paper Trading balance whenever you want, since it's designed for repeated practice sessions.
